name: ownvoice
description: Write, rewrite, and reply to emails and messages in your own voice.

interface.longDescription: Write, rewrite, and reply to emails and messages with tone suited to the recipient. OwnVoice supports English and Hinglish, can match user-provided writing samples, and preserves facts, uncertainty, and commitments. It prepares drafts and does not send messages.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite my email to sound natural and direct.
Draft a friendly reply in Hinglish.
Use my writing samples to match my voice.
